invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null iterator due to guaranteed return from IOUtils.runMerge.
fileId is needed to get the update handle and run the merge, thus should not be null at exit.
instantTime is passed to multiple downstream calls and must not be null.
The update handle requires a valid keyToNewRecords map.
oldDataFile is passed to downstream handle and should be non-null for an update.
